title: Check: mock exam 1 review
description: Five questions on the tasks this simulation drills.

questions.prompt: Write the fastest command that creates a Pod named nginx from image nginx.
questions.explanation: `kubectl run` makes Pods; `kubectl create deployment` makes Deployments. Knowing which is which saves a correction.

questions.prompt: Write the command that scales Deployment web to 5 replicas.
questions.explanation: Imperative scaling is far faster than editing YAML under time pressure.

questions.prompt: A task says to save output to a file. What is the risk?

options.text: Writing to the wrong path or node scores zero even though the command was right
The file is deleted at the end

questions.explanation: Read the path literally and check with `cat` afterwards. Graders look exactly where they said.

questions.prompt: After completing a task, what should you always do?

options.text: Verify with a get or describe that the cluster is in the asked-for state
Delete the object and redo it

questions.explanation: A typo you never look at costs the whole task. Verification takes seconds.

questions.prompt: Why prefer imperative commands with --dry-run=client -o yaml?

options.text: They are the only supported way
They produce a correct skeleton fast, which you then edit

questions.explanation: You get valid YAML without remembering field names, then change the two lines that matter.
